messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout starting now for release x.y.3 across services: api v3.2.1, runtime v2.9.0-rc3, router v1.5.0, console v0.14. Change window 30m. Canary: 5% traffic. CI: green.

alice.release: heads up — coordinating cross-service canary. ben, carmen, infra: please watch your dashboards and confirm health checks.

ben.runtime: watching runtime canary logs. quick note: rc3 has new KV cache change; latency might spike under 1k concurrent keys. I’ll keep an eye.

carmen.api: API client tests passed against api v3.2.1. No contract changes, just a small header change documented in release notes.

infra-oncall: router team flagged sticky session config diff between v1.4 and v1.5 — we patched sticky cookie handling. Will monitor connection churn.

alice.release: rollback plan: full rollback if 5xx > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes OR P90 latency > 350ms for 3m. Partial rollback allowed (runtime only) if errors tied to KV/cache traces.

deploy-bot: Canary update: api v3.2.1 -> 5% traffic routed (router: canary-rule #742). Logs: no errors.

ben.runtime: canary runtime pods show 0.8% 5xx increased at +2m, correlated with cache-miss spike. Investigating whether kernel selection change in rc3 is causing regressions.

carmen.api: I see a small uptick in client retries (0.6%) overall, but trace shows runtime downstream 502s. Looks runtime-related.

devex-tom: console: during canary the console frontend fetches model metadata from runtime admin endpoints. If runtime is rolled back, console should continue to work but we need to pin console to runtime-compatible metadata version. Can we pin console to metadata v2026-03-10?

ben.runtime: confirmed: runtime traces show kv_get latency up to 220ms for some keys. Stack shows new attention cache path used for long sequences. I'll flip a config flag to force old path on canary pods for quick mitigation. Command I’ll run: `kubectl exec -n prod deploy/runtime-canary -- sh -c '
  echo "USE_LEGACY_KV=1" > /etc/runtime/conf.d/legacy_kv.conf
  supervisorctl restart runtime
'`

infra-oncall: router health probes still green. curl canary health: `curl -sS -D - http://router-canary.internal/_health | grep HTTP/1.1` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK.

deploy-bot: Canary update: runtime config flip applied to canary pods. Traffic steady. Monitoring metrics.

ben.runtime: after flip p95 latency dropped and 5xx back to 0.2% over 3m. Looks like legacy path mitigated. I recommend holding rollout and running extended canary to 15% for 10m before full rollout.

alice.release: proposal: pause full rollout, increase canary to 15% for 10m, leave api/router as planned, do not promote runtime to all nodes yet. Carmen — any objections from API side?

carmen.api: okay with that. API stable. We'll note in release notes that runtime remains rc3 but with legacy_kv enabled by default for now. Also will pin api clients to api v3.2.1.

devex-tom: console team: fine with the metadata pin. We'll add a console migration flag to release PR so on full runtime promotion we bump metadata version.

alice.release: decision logged: HOLD rollout. Runtime promotion deferred; canary -> 15% for 10m, then reassess. Record in release notes and change window.

deploy-bot: Action items created: RH-1984 (runtime: validate rc3 with legacy_kv), RH-1985 (router: extend canary rule), RH-1986 (docs: update release notes + console pin).

infra-oncall: I’ll keep router ready to rollback canary rule if any routing anomalies.

ben.runtime: running extended canary smoke now. Will post metrics in 8m.

alice.release: thanks everyone — keep threads short. If any of you see 5xx spike >1% or p90 >350ms, @alice.release and @infra-oncall get paged and we initiate rollback plan.

(9m later)

bent.runtime (edited): extended canary metrics: 5xx=0.15%, p95=120ms, p90=85ms. all green.

alice.release: ok — reconvene at +10m. If green we will schedule runtime promotion to 50% then 100% over a 20m window, and update release notes to say runtime rc3 with legacy_kv compat flag.

carmen.api: I'll update the changelog snippet and ping PM for customer-facing note.

deploy-bot: Canary progression: runtime -> 15% (increased), next check at 10m.
